messages.subject: trouble with activityoverlap and activitydensity
parts:
All, hi and thank you in advance for reading!

So I'm kind of "new" to camtrap R, been exploring it for the last two weeks. So far so good and I find it really useful. However, I am having trouble with the activityoverlap and activitydensity functions.
Specifically, when I try to plot the activity of a given species, or of two species in the case of activity overlap, I get the following error:

Error: all(c(speciesA, speciesB) %in% recordTable[, speciesCol]) is not TRUE

However, this does not happen when I plot the graphs for ALL the species (using AllSpecies=TRUE argument in activitydensity). In that case I get all the plots correctly. I checked many times my records table and all the species names are alright and they match... I really do not know what could the problem be. Any help would be much appreciated.

For example, this is the code I am trying to use for activity overlap:

Zorro<-"Lgymnocercus"
Gatomonte<-"Ogeoffroyi"

activityOverlap (recordTable = All,
                 speciesA    = "Lgymnocercus",
                 speciesB    = "Ogeoffroyi",
                 speciesCol = "Species",
                 writePNG    = FALSE,
                 plotR       = TRUE,
                 add.rug     = TRUE)

messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: trouble with activityoverlap and activitydensity
parts:
Hi Sofia,
it is difficult to say without the actual data. I don't know what the issue is if the species names match the ones in the table exactly. 

So I guess you checked with something like this:

sum("Lgymnocercus" %in% All$Species)
sum("Ogeoffroyi"  %in% All$Species)

The number shows the respective number of records and should not be 0.

Would you mind sharing a part of the record table to reproduce the error please? You can send via email if you prefer not to share publicly. 
Thank you,
Jürgen

parts:
Hi Juergen, thank you so much for your reply! below you will find the specifications.

And again thank you very much.
Best,

Sofía.

I hadn't check the way you suggested (sum("Lgymnocercus" %in% All$Species), but when I did it was indeed 0. This is strange... attached is a prior table I've been using.

(In the table the species names are: L.gymnocercus, O. geoffroyi, etc because first I thought that species names with "." might be an issue, but it still happened when I erased the "." so just overlook that).

here's the script:
Mamanta<- read.table("helptable.txt", sep="\t", header= T)
str(Mamanta)

Zorro<-"L.gymnocercus"
Gatomonte<-"O.geoffroyi"
activityDensity(recordTable=Mamanta, allSpecies=TRUE, speciesCol="Species", recordDateTimeFormat = "%d/%m/%Y %H:%M")
?activityDensity

#for some reason that works.. but if I chose a specific species it does not.
activityOverlap (recordTable = Mamanta,
                 speciesA    = Zorro,
                 speciesB    = Gatomonte,

speciesCol = "Species",
                 writePNG    = FALSE,
                 plotR       = TRUE,
                 add.rug     = TRUE)
